title: Warzone drops PS4 and Xbox One as Season 1 hits 🎯
subject: warzone
description:
Were you still playing Warzone on PS4 or Xbox One? 👇

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone Season 1 went live at midnight ET on November 6, 2026, and Warzone is no longer playable on PS4 and Xbox One. Progress carries over with the same Activision account. The season adds Hajin, a new battle royale map on the Korean Peninsula with 13 major POIs, the Zodiac Resurgence map from Beenox and Infinity Ward, and all 33 MW4 launch weapons.

Sources: Call of Duty Blog (Nov 2, 2026), Windows Central, Pure Xbox (Nov 1, 2026)

scenes.text: Warzone no longer runs on PS4 or Xbox One.

scenes.text: Modern Warfare 4's Season 1 went live on November 6, and last-gen support ended with it.
Your progress carries over if you log in on another platform with the same Activision account.

scenes.text: The new battle royale map, Hajin, sits on the Korean Peninsula with 13 major locations.
Beenox built a second map, Zodiac, around the headquarters of drone company DRC Advanced Systems.
All 33 launch weapons are unlocked, and Verdansk returns later in the season.
